## Notes

- **`shop`** is off by default. `stack add shop` adds it to a site generated
  without it.
- **`search`** indexes pages (and products) as they are saved; content that
  existed before the feature was added is indexed the next time it is saved.
- **`redirects`** are checked only when a page is not found.
